identity.name: E1
identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

theme_strategy.reasoning: Light mode conveys trust, clarity, and readability for data-heavy financial applications in a wholesale context. It aligns with the 'daytime business' nature of the user.

usage_rules.headings: Use 'Manrope' for all headings (h1-h6). Weight: 600 or 700. Tracking: tight (-0.02em).
usage_rules.body: Use 'Inter' for all UI text, labels, and paragraphs. Weight: 400 (regular) or 500 (medium).
usage_rules.numbers: Use 'JetBrains Mono' for ALL financial data, prices, and ledger entries to ensure tabular alignment.
usage_rules.label: text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide

rules.gradients: Avoid gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors for clarity.
rules.text_contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Use Slate-900 for primary text, Slate-500 for secondary.

buttons.primary: bg-brand-600 text-white hover:bg-brand-700 shadow-sm font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-all
buttons.destructive: bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 shadow-sm font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md

cards.base: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6
cards.interactive: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 hover:border-brand-200 hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer

inputs.base: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-white file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-slate-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

tables.wrapper: w-full overflow-auto rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm
tables.header: bg-slate-50 text-left text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-slate-200

badges.success: inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700 ring-1 ring-inset ring-emerald-600/20
badges.warning: inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-amber-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-amber-700 ring-1 ring-inset ring-amber-600/20
badges.error: inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-rose-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-rose-700 ring-1 ring-inset ring-rose-600/20
badges.neutral: inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-slate-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 ring-1 ring-inset ring-slate-500/10

images.description: Modern clean warehouse interior, suitable for login/signup page background. Use with a dark overlay (bg-slate-900/60) for text readability.
Clean minimalist office desk, can be used for empty states or welcome screens.

visual_enhancers.patterns: Subtle dot pattern (bg-[url('...')] opacity-[0.02]) on the main background if needed, but prefer clean solid colors.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-brand-600) on all interactive elements.

motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders (animate-pulse bg-slate-200) instead of spinners for content loading.

universal_guidelines: Do not use 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Manrope'.
Do not use gradients for text or buttons. Keep it flat and clean.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all currency and numerical data.
Use generous padding. Don't cram content.
All interactive elements must have a 'data-testid' attribute.
